note: Four real boards across three applicant-tracking systems, plus one board that is broken on purpose. Every token here was probed with a single read-only GET on 2026-11-09 before being written down: boards-api.greenhouse.io/reddit, api.lever.co/spotify, api.ashbyhq.com/ramp and api.ashbyhq.com/linear each answered 200; api.lever.co/matterport, /plaid and /mistral answered 404 and are therefore not in the plan.
expect_at_least_note: The floors are 1, not a guess at each board's real size. I do not know how many postings these boards carry and will not pretend to; what I am willing to assert by hand is that a live public job board answering 200 with zero postings is not something I believe without checking. tools/crosscheck.py turns that belief into a flag.

boards.why: GATE.md §4 demonstration: an unknown board token. Predicted before running: classification `permanent`, zero retries, the board reported as failed with no count, the run exits `incomplete`, and the other four boards still produce their postings.
